Damian Lillard was COOKING against the Milwaukee Bucks, finishing with 33 points, 6 rebounds, and 5 three-pointers on an efficient 10-of-18 shooting performance! Dame delivered a scoring masterclass as the Portland Trail Blazers battled their way to a 124-114 victory in a tightly contested matchup featuring 20 lead changes and 8 ties.
